def MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn.{u_1, u_3} : {α : Type u_1} →
  {ε : Type u_3} →
    {mα : MeasurableSpace α} →
      [inst : TopologicalSpace ε] →
        [ContinuousENorm ε] →
          (α → ε) → Set α → autoParam (MeasureTheory.Measure α) MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn._auto_1 → Prop :=
fun {α} {ε} {mα} [TopologicalSpace ε] [ContinuousENorm ε] f s μ => MeasureTheory.Integrable f (μ.restrict s)
def MeasureTheory.Integrable.{u_5, u_8} : {ε : Type u_5} →
  [inst : TopologicalSpace ε] →
    [ContinuousENorm ε] →
      {α : Type u_8} →
        {x : MeasurableSpace α} →
          (α → ε) → autoParam (MeasureTheory.Measure α) MeasureTheory.Integrable._auto_1 → Prop :=
fun {ε} [TopologicalSpace ε] [ContinuousENorm ε] {α} {x} f μ =>
  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f μ ∧ MeasureTheory.HasFiniteIntegral f μ
def MeasureTheory.HasFiniteIntegral.{u_1, u_4} : {α : Type u_1} →
  {ε : Type u_4} →
    [ENorm ε] →
      {x : MeasurableSpace α} →
        (α → ε) → autoParam (MeasureTheory.Measure α) MeasureTheory.HasFiniteIntegral._auto_1 → Prop :=
fun {α} {ε} [ENorm ε] {x} f μ => ∫⁻ (a : α), ‖f a‖ₑ ∂μ < ⊤
@MeasureTheory.hasFiniteIntegral_iff_norm : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {m : MeasurableSpace α}
  {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup β] (f : α → β),
  MeasureTheory.HasFiniteIntegral f μ ↔ ∫⁻ (a : α), ENNReal.ofReal ‖f a‖ ∂μ < ⊤
def MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.{u_1, u_2} : {α : Type u_1} →
  {β : Type u_2} →
    [TopologicalSpace β] →
      [m : MeasurableSpace α] →
        {m₀ : MeasurableSpace α} →
          (α → β) → autoParam (MeasureTheory.Measure α) MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable._auto_1 → Prop :=
fun {α} {β} [TopologicalSpace β] [MeasurableSpace α] {m₀} f μ => ∃ g, MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable g ∧ f =ᵐ[μ] g
def MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable.{u_1, u_2} : {α : Type u_1} →
  {β : Type u_2} → [TopologicalSpace β] → [MeasurableSpace α] → (α → β) → Prop :=
fun {α} {β} [TopologicalSpace β] [MeasurableSpace α] f =>
  ∃ fs, ∀ (x : α), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (fs n) x) Filter.atTop (nhds (f x))
structure MeasureTheory.SimpleFunc.{u, v} (α : Type u) [MeasurableSpace α] (β : Type v) : Type (max u v)
number of parameters: 3
fields:
  MeasureTheory.SimpleFunc.toFun : α → β
  MeasureTheory.SimpleFunc.measurableSet_fiber' : ∀ (x : β), MeasurableSet (self.toFun ⁻¹' {x})
  MeasureTheory.SimpleFunc.finite_range' : (Set.range self.toFun).Finite
constructor:
  MeasureTheory.SimpleFunc.mk.{u, v} {α : Type u} [MeasurableSpace α] {β : Type v} (toFun : α → β)
    (measurableSet_fiber' : ∀ (x : β), MeasurableSet (toFun ⁻¹' {x})) (finite_range' : (Set.range toFun).Finite) :
    MeasureTheory.SimpleFunc α β
@MeasureTheory.lintegral_def : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace α} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α) (f : α → ENNReal),
  MeasureTheory.lintegral μ f = ⨆ g, ⨆ (_ : ⇑g ≤ f), g.lintegral μ
def MeasureTheory.SimpleFunc.lintegral.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →
  {_m : MeasurableSpace α} → MeasureTheory.SimpleFunc α ENNReal → MeasureTheory.Measure α → ENNReal :=
fun {α} {_m} f μ => ∑ x ∈ f.range, x * μ (⇑f ⁻¹' {x})

@MeasureTheory.integral_def : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup G] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ G]
  {x : MeasurableSpace α} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α) (f : α → G),
  MeasureTheory.integral μ f =
    if x_1 : CompleteSpace G then
      if hf : MeasureTheory.Integrable f μ then MeasureTheory.L1.integral (MeasureTheory.Integrable.toL1 f hf) else 0
    else 0
@MeasureTheory.integral_eq : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E]
  {m : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [hE : CompleteSpace E] (f : α → E)
  (hf : MeasureTheory.Integrable f μ),
  ∫ (a : α), f a ∂μ = MeasureTheory.L1.integral (MeasureTheory.Integrable.toL1 f hf)
@MeasureTheory.Integrable.coeFn_toL1 : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {m : MeasurableSpace α}
  {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup β] {f : α → β} (hf : MeasureTheory.Integrable f μ),
  ↑↑(MeasureTheory.Integrable.toL1 f hf) =ᵐ[μ] f
@MeasureTheory.L1.integral_def : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] {m : MeasurableSpace α}
  {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E],
  MeasureTheory.L1.integral = ⇑MeasureTheory.L1.integralCLM
@MeasureTheory.L1.integral_eq : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] {m : MeasurableSpace α}
  {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] (f : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp E 1 μ)),
  MeasureTheory.L1.integral f = MeasureTheory.L1.integralCLM f
def MeasureTheory.L1.integralCLM.{u_1, u_2} : {α : Type u_1} →
  {E : Type u_2} →
    [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
      {m : MeasurableSpace α} →
        {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} →
          [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] → [CompleteSpace E] → ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp E 1 μ) →L[ℝ] E :=
fun {α} {E} [NormedAddCommGroup E] {m} {μ} [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] => MeasureTheory.L1.integralCLM' ℝ
def MeasureTheory.L1.integralCLM'.{u_1, u_2, u_4} : {α : Type u_1} →
  {E : Type u_2} →
    (𝕜 : Type u_4) →
      [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
        {m : MeasurableSpace α} →
          {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} →
            [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] →
              [inst_2 : NormedRing 𝕜] →
                [inst_3 : Module 𝕜 E] →
                  [inst_4 : IsBoundedSMul 𝕜 E] →
                    [SMulCommClass ℝ 𝕜 E] → [CompleteSpace E] → ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp E 1 μ) →L[𝕜] E :=
fun {α} {E} 𝕜 [NormedAddCommGroup E] {m} {μ} [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedRing 𝕜] [Module 𝕜 E] [IsBoundedSMul 𝕜 E]
    [SMulCommClass ℝ 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E] =>
  (MeasureTheory.L1.SimpleFunc.integralCLM' α E 𝕜 μ).extend (MeasureTheory.Lp.simpleFunc.coeToLp α E 𝕜)
@ContinuousLinearMap.extend_eq : ∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} {𝕜₂ : Type u_2} {E : Type u_3} {Eₗ : Type u_4} {F : Type u_5}
  [inst : AddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : UniformSpace E] [inst_2 : IsUniformAddGroup E] [inst_3 : AddCommGroup F]
  [inst_4 : UniformSpace F] [inst_5 : IsUniformAddGroup F] [inst_6 : T0Space F] [inst_7 : AddCommMonoid Eₗ]
  [inst_8 : UniformSpace Eₗ] [inst_9 : ContinuousAdd Eₗ] [inst_10 : Semiring 𝕜] [inst_11 : Semiring 𝕜₂]
  [inst_12 : Module 𝕜 E] [inst_13 : Module 𝕜₂ F] [inst_14 : Module 𝕜 Eₗ] [inst_15 : ContinuousConstSMul 𝕜 Eₗ]
  [inst_16 : ContinuousConstSMul 𝕜₂ F] {σ₁₂ : 𝕜 →+* 𝕜₂} (f : E →SL[σ₁₂] F) [inst_17 : CompleteSpace F] {e : E →L[𝕜] Eₗ},
  DenseRange ⇑e → IsUniformInducing ⇑e → ∀ (x : E), (f.extend e) (e x) = f x
@ContinuousLinearMap.extend_unique : ∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} {𝕜₂ : Type u_2} {E : Type u_3} {Eₗ : Type u_4} {F : Type u_5}
  [inst : AddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : UniformSpace E] [inst_2 : IsUniformAddGroup E] [inst_3 : AddCommGroup F]
  [inst_4 : UniformSpace F] [inst_5 : IsUniformAddGroup F] [inst_6 : T0Space F] [inst_7 : AddCommMonoid Eₗ]
  [inst_8 : UniformSpace Eₗ] [inst_9 : ContinuousAdd Eₗ] [inst_10 : Semiring 𝕜] [inst_11 : Semiring 𝕜₂]
  [inst_12 : Module 𝕜 E] [inst_13 : Module 𝕜₂ F] [inst_14 : Module 𝕜 Eₗ] [inst_15 : ContinuousConstSMul 𝕜 Eₗ]
  [inst_16 : ContinuousConstSMul 𝕜₂ F] {σ₁₂ : 𝕜 →+* 𝕜₂} (f : E →SL[σ₁₂] F) [inst_17 : CompleteSpace F] {e : E →L[𝕜] Eₗ},
  DenseRange ⇑e → IsUniformInducing ⇑e → ∀ (g : Eₗ →SL[σ₁₂] F), g.comp e = f → f.extend e = g
@MeasureTheory.Lp.simpleFunc.denseRange : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace α]
  [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] {p : ENNReal} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [inst_2 : Fact (1 ≤ p)],
  p ≠ ⊤ → DenseRange Subtype.val
@MeasureTheory.L1.SimpleFunc.integral_eq_integral : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  {m : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E]
  (f : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp.simpleFunc E 1 μ)),
  MeasureTheory.L1.SimpleFunc.integral f =
    MeasureTheory.SimpleFunc.integral μ (MeasureTheory.Lp.simpleFunc.toSimpleFunc f)
@MeasureTheory.L1.SimpleFunc.integral_L1_eq_integral : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  {m : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  (f : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp.simpleFunc E 1 μ)), MeasureTheory.L1.integral ↑f = MeasureTheory.L1.SimpleFunc.integral f
@MeasureTheory.SimpleFunc.integral_eq : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup F]
  [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ F] {m : MeasurableSpace α} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α) (f : MeasureTheory.SimpleFunc α F),
  MeasureTheory.SimpleFunc.integral μ f = ∑ x ∈ f.range, μ.real (⇑f ⁻¹' {x}) • x
@MeasureTheory.SimpleFunc.integral_eq_sum : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] {m : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [hE : CompleteSpace E]
  (f : MeasureTheory.SimpleFunc α E),
  MeasureTheory.Integrable (⇑f) μ → ∫ (x : α), f x ∂μ = ∑ x ∈ f.range, μ.real (⇑f ⁻¹' {x}) • x
@MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_of_L1 : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup G]
  [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ G] {m : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {ι : Type u_3} (f : α → G),
  MeasureTheory.Integrable f μ →
    ∀ {F : ι → α → G} {l : Filter ι},
      (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in l, MeasureTheory.Integrable (F i) μ) →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun i => ∫⁻ (x : α), ‖F i x - f x‖ₑ ∂μ) l (nhds 0) →
          Filter.Tendsto (fun i => ∫ (x : α), F i x ∂μ) l (nhds (∫ (x : α), f x ∂μ))
@MeasureTheory.integral_undef : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup G] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ G]
  {m : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {f : α → G},
  ¬MeasureTheory.Integrable f μ → ∫ (a : α), f a ∂μ = 0
@MeasureTheory.integral_const : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E]
  {m : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [hE : CompleteSpace E] (c : E),
  ∫ (x : α), c ∂μ = μ.real Set.univ • c
@MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup G]
  [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ G] {m : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {f g : α → G},
  f =ᵐ[μ] g → ∫ (a : α), f a ∂μ = ∫ (a : α), g a ∂μ
